title: Tumbbad
description: A family builds a shrine for Hastar, a dangerous monster. When they try to take his cursed treasure, scary things start happening, and their lives turn into a nightmare.

title: Mr. India
description: Arun shelters a group of orphans and is harassed by a gangster eyeing his house. After a child dies, he uses his father's invisibility watch to fight back.

title: Kalki 2898 AD
description: In a ravaged world, a brave group races to protect a woman carrying Lord Vishnu's final avatar, Kalki, from Yaskin - the ruthless god-king bent on destroying her destiny.

title: Ek Aur Ek Gyarah
description: Tara and Sitara, thieves, hide in Major Ram Singh's house. When Cobra kidnaps their mother, they must deceive Ram to save her and free Panther.

title: Saturday Blockbuster- Wanted
description: Fearless hitman Radhe operates without mercy for anyone who pays, yet he desperately seeks redemption after falling hard for Jhanvi, who despises his brutal, violent life of crime.

title: Singh Is King
description: Happy, known for his wild antics, is sent to bring Lakhan to his ailing father. In Australia, events take a turn as Happy accidentally assumes Lakhan's role as the local underworld king.

title: Ram Teri Ganga Maili
description: Ganga sets out for Calcutta with her son after her husband leaves them. Hoping for a better life, she is betrayed along the way and ends up trapped in a brothel.

title: Kya Kool Hain Hum 3
description: Kanhaiya, an adult film actor in Thailand, falls for Shalu. To win over her traditional father, he fakes a respectable family with help from his quirky co-stars.

title: Turtle
description: Ramkaran struggles to extract water in a drought-hit village. As thirst grows, villagers search for desperate solutions, revealing the harsh realities of survival and hope.

title: Thalapathy Is The G.O.A.T.
description: Gandhi, an undercover agent, faces turmoil after a tragic mission. Years later, he encounters a young man claiming to be his son, Jeevan. Secrets unravel as danger looms.

title: Air India Around the World- Hum Saath Saath Hain
description: Ramkishan and Mamta live happily with their sons. But when tragedy strikes their daughter, Mamta's heart changes, and she turns against her kind stepson, Vivek.

title: Baazigar
description: A ruthless killer seeking revenge seduces a businessman's elder daughter, stages her murder as suicide, then sets out to destroy the rest of her family.

title: Super Cinema Blockbuster- Sholay
description: Thakur Baldev hires Jai and Veeru to capture Gabbar, the dacoit who wiped out his family. They find love along the way, but fate decides otherwise.

title: Mega Double Premiere - Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata
description: Amid the ravaging events of the 26/11 attacks, chaos, pain and darkness take over the Cama Hospital. 400 patients turn to the hospital workers to get them through a catastrophe.
